question: A solid sphere is rolling down an inclined plane of inclination θ without slipping. The acceleration of the sphere is:
explanation: a = g sinθ / (1 + I / (MR²)) = g sinθ / (1 + 2/5) = g sinθ / (7/5) = (5/7) g sinθ. | Hint: a = g sinθ / (1 + k²/R²). For solid sphere k²/R² = 2/5.

question: Find the torque about the origin when a force of 3 j N acts on a particle whose position vector is 2 k m:
explanation: τ = r × F = (2 k) × (3 j) = 6 (k × j) = 6 (-i) = -6 i N·m. | Hint: k × j = -i in right-hand coordinate system.

question: A uniform rod of length 200 cm and mass 500 g is balanced on a wedge placed at 40 cm mark. A mass of 2 kg is suspended at 20 cm mark. Where should another mass m be suspended to maintain equilibrium?
options: Torque about fulcrum must sum to zero
explanation: Center of gravity of rod is at 100 cm (distance 60 cm from 40 cm wedge). Left torque = 2g × (40 - 20) = 40g. Right torque from rod = 0.5g × (100 - 40) = 30g. Counter-torque of 10g needed to balance. | Hint: Apply principle of moments about the fulcrum.

question: A uniform rod of mass 20 kg and length 5 m leans against a smooth vertical wall making an angle of 60° with it. The other end rests on a rough horizontal floor. The friction force that the floor exerts on the rod is (Take g = 10 m/s²)
explanation: Torque about floor contact: f = (Mg/2)cot 30° = 100√3 N.

question: An energy of 484 J is spent in increasing the speed of a flywheel from 60 rpm to 360 rpm. The moment of inertia of the flywheel is :
explanation: ½I(ω₂²−ω₁²) = 484 with ω = 2π(rpm/60): ½I·4π²(144−1) = 484 ⇒ I ≈ 0.7 kg m⁻².
source: ExamSIDE.com NEET 2022 Phase 2 PYQ + solution; verified by derivation

question: The ratio of the radius of gyration of a thin uniform circular disc about its diameter to that about an axis perpendicular to the plane and passing through its centre is:
explanation: I_diameter = (1/4) M R² ⇒ k₁ = R/2. I_perpendicular = (1/2) M R² ⇒ k₂ = R/√2. Ratio k₁ / k₂ = (R/2) / (R/√2) = √2 / 2 = 1 / √2. | Hint: Compare radii of gyration k = √(I / M).

question: The angular speed of a flywheel is increased from 600 rpm to 1200 rpm in 10 s. The number of revolutions completed by the flywheel during this time is:
explanation: θ = (ω₁+ω₂)/2 × t = 900 rev/min × 10 s = 150 rev.

question: When a mass is rotating in a plane about a fixed point, its angular momentum is directed along
options: a line perpendicular to the plane of rotation
the line making an angle of 45° to the plane of rotation
explanation: For rotation in a plane, L = r × p is perpendicular to that plane (right-hand rule).
source: ExamSIDE.com AIPMT 2012 PYQ + solution; verified by definition L = r × p

question: The Sun rotates around its centre once in 27 days. What will be the period of revolution if the Sun were to expand to twice its present radius without any external influence? Assume the Sun to be a sphere of uniform density.
explanation: L conserved: I ∝ R² → I′ = 4I → ω′ = ω/4 → T′ = 108 days.

question: Three objects, A : (a solid sphere), B : (a thin circular disk) and C : (a circular ring), each have the same mass M and radius R. They all spin with the same angular speed ω about their own symmetry axes. The amounts of work (W) required to bring them to rest, would satisfy the relation
explanation: W ∝ I at same ω; I_ring > I_disc > I_sphere.

question: A disc of radius 2 m and mass 100 kg rolls on a horizontal floor. Its centre of mass has speed of 20 cm/s. How much work is needed to stop it?
explanation: KE = ½mv² + ½(½MR²)ω² = 2 + 1 = 3 J.

question: A rope is wound around a hollow cylinder of mass 3 kg and radius 40 cm. What is the angular acceleration of the cylinder if the rope is pulled with a force of 30 N?
explanation: τ = F·R = 12 N m; I = MR² = 3(0.4)² = 0.48 kg m² ⇒ α = τ/I = 25 rad s⁻².
source: ExamSIDE.com NEET 2017 PYQ + solution; verified by derivation

question: A solid cylinder of mass 50 kg and radius 0.5 m is free to rotate about the horizontal axis. A massless string is wound round the cylinder with one end attached to it and other hanging freely. Tension in the string required to produce an angular acceleration of 2 revolutions s⁻² is
explanation: α = 2 rev/s² = 4π rad/s²; τ = Iα = ½MR²·4π = 25π N m ⇒ T = τ/R = 50π ≈ 157 N.
source: ExamSIDE.com AIPMT 2014 PYQ + solution; verified by derivation

question: A solid sphere is in rolling motion. In rolling motion a body possesses translational kinetic energy (Kₜ) as well as rotational kinetic energy (Kᵣ) simultaneously. The ratio Kₜ : (Kₜ + Kᵣ) for the sphere is
explanation: Kᵣ = (1/5)mv²; total = (7/10)mv² → ratio 5:7.

question: A solid sphere is rotating freely about its symmetry axis in free space. The radius of the sphere is increased keeping its mass same. Which of the following physical quantities would remain constant for the sphere?
explanation: No external torque → L = Iω conserved.
